initialExam.title: TNPSC Group 1 Services 2026
initialExam.description: TNPSC Group 1 exam for recruitment to senior administrative posts in Tamil Nadu state government including Deputy Collector, DSP, and Assistant Commissioner.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: General Studies (200Q - 300 marks, 3 hours) + CSAT (100Q - 200 marks, 2 hours). Mains: Tamil, English, General Studies I-IV.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: Objective (CSAT qualifying only). Mains: 4 descriptive papers + Interview.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Prelims → Mains → Interview → Document Verification → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Deputy Collector, DSP, Assistant Commissioner, District Registrar
initialExam.careerGrowth: Deputy Collector → Joint Collector → District Collector → Commissioner → Additional Chief Secretary.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit tnpsc.gov.in 2. One-time registration 3. Fill application 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Medical, Pension, Government quarters

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
